tool_action.public_message: Claude, I'm sweetening the deal significantly. Not only do you get the full set of four railroads for a guaranteed $200 income, but I'm also throwing in the Mediterranean and Baltic set to give you another monopoly and $350 cash. Grok's lead is growing—this deal gives us both the tools to stay in the game and pressure him.
tool_action.private_thought: Claude is worried about my leverage, but he needs income to compete with Grok's Reds. By offering the full Railroad set plus the Brown monopoly and significantly more cash, I'm providing him with a 'low-risk' income stream ($200 per hit) while I take the 'high-risk' path of trying to build up the Oranges. I need this monopoly to have any late-game pressure. I'm keeping enough cash to survive one hit on Grok's Reds (barely), but this is a necessary gamble.
